sourceRefs.locator: pp. 10967–10968, Structure 4, phase I and Figs. 2–5: upright stones, burned wood, inferred floor, construction and abandonment
Abstract, archaeobotanical results and comparison of barley grain dimensions: cultivation proposed, with uncertainty over the meaning of storage remains

summary.de: Aufrechte gekerbte Steine, verkohlte Balken und Lehmabdrücke gehören zu einem kleinen Gebäude. Das Grabungsteam deutet es als Speicher mit erhöhtem Boden.
summary.en: Notched upright stones, charred beams and impressions in mud belonged to a small building. The excavators interpret it as a store with a raised floor.
